args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1-rc or any other version — the rollback went to the last known-healthy production release as requested.
